title: AI辅助开源软件投稿预审：来自BOSC 2026的经验报告
summary: 本文报告了在BOSC 2026会议上使用生成式AI辅助预审开源软件投稿的经验。他们构建了bosc-pre-review智能体技能和Runabilly工具，在Docker容器中安全构建测试项目，为审稿人提供证据。调查显示多数审稿人认为有用，但更倾向于自行核实AI结论。
summary_en: This paper reports an experience using generative AI to pre-review open-source software submissions at BOSC 2026. They built an agentic skill and a Docker-based tool to gather evidence for reviewers. Survey showed reviewers found it useful but preferred to verify AI conclusions themselves.
